# V1.5.6

Section: Source

**V1.5.6** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on July 29th, 2022.

## V1.5.6

- Feature - Functional Weapons Outfits ([#7960](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/7960) [#3217](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/3217))

In this update we have added 5 new outfits that protect the player against projectile and explosive damage at the expense of slowing down the player's movement speed. Most of the new outfits include a helmet which will additionally reduce headshot damage.

- Fix - Player now orients to the look direction when walking (using walk hotkey)
- Fix - [#10701](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/10701) Audio settings tab sliders not applying correctly
- Fix - [#11200](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/11200) Fix default weapons script breaking when failing to spawn a turret
- Fix - Fix onButtonPress event interactions with instrument panel buttons
- Fix - Updated several component descriptions that were using hard coded hotkeys in descriptions
- Fix - [#11642](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/11642) Adjusted mounted end-effector raycast to begin within the component
- Fix - [#11676](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/11676) Mesh issues between arctic airport and main island
- Fix - [#11717](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/11717) Gyro now creates editor warning when electric is not connected
- Fix - [#11746](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/11746) Speargun inventory spelling error
- Fix - [#11805](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/11805) [#11754](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/11754) Leaks now occur for voxels that take more than 1 damage in a single instance
